subject: Re: Voice message: quotation request from Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
body:
Hello Ms Berger,

Thank you for your reply. We do not know the departure airport. Please arrange pickup by truck from our site in 42925, Germany, and select the departure airport for the fastest option to JFK.

The shipment is 8 pieces of laboratory glassware, with a total gross weight of 959 kg and a volume of 8.04 cbm. The goods are ready for pickup on 26 November 2026.

Please send us your all-in offer for the fastest option.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
